drafted_from: tool:run-an-installed-apps-command-line row in tool-rows.json, do-work/run-installed-cli and test/run-installed-cli.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run the command line inside my installed Zorblet app with render --out clip.mp4; the entry is Contents/Resources/app.asar.unpacked/node_modules/zorblet/bin/zorblet.mjs." It runs the app's own program on your computer and reports what it printed and its exit code.
no_lists_because: It names no list: it launches the command-line entry an installed app keeps inside itself and passes the app's own output and exit code back.
instructions: 1. Find where the app is installed (for example /Applications/Zorblet.app) and look inside it for its command-line entry; for an Electron app it is usually under Contents/Resources/app.asar.unpacked/node_modules/<name>/bin/.

2. Say "Run the command line of <app>" with the app, the entry and the app's own arguments; your AI reads the row with tools:list and runs `sh tools/run-an-installed-apps-command-line/do-work/run-installed-cli <app> <entry> <arguments>` from the Workshop checkout, each argument quoted as one word.
3. Read what the app printed and its exit code: a .mjs, .cjs or .js entry runs under node, any other entry runs as itself, and every argument is passed through unchanged.
4. Exit code 2 with {"error": "what to pass"} on standard error means the app or entry is missing or the entry is not a program; pass what it asks for and run it again.

worked_examples.title: A made-up app's JavaScript entry gets its arguments exactly
worked_examples.ask: Run the command line inside my Zorblet app: render --out "a file with spaces.mp4".
worked_examples.given: From tools/run-an-installed-apps-command-line/test/run-installed-cli.test.mjs: the app is Zorblet.app, whose entry Contents/Resources/app.asar.unpacked/node_modules/zorblet/bin/zorblet.mjs prints the JSON of its arguments. The command line is `sh tools/run-an-installed-apps-command-line/do-work/run-installed-cli Zorblet.app Contents/Resources/app.asar.unpacked/node_modules/zorblet/bin/zorblet.mjs render --out 'a file with spaces.mp4' ''`.
worked_examples.hands_back: Standard output {"argv":["render","--out","a file with spaces.mp4",""]} and exit code 0: node ran the entry and every argument arrived as one word, the empty one too. With the environment ZORBLET_EXIT=7 the exit code is 7; for an entry that is not a program (notes.txt) it exits 2 and prints {"error": "... is not executable: pass the app's command-line program, or a .mjs, .cjs or .js entry"} on standard error.
